request_user:
Fact: design_rationale
What to find: How and why key design choices in training were made.
Card sections that often contain it: Training, Design

Answer with status, value, quotes and section.

answer.value: The card gives rationales for some design choices. Hybrid attention (local sliding window interleaved with global) gives the speed and low memory footprint of a lightweight model without losing deep awareness for long-context tasks. Training data includes code to learn programming syntax and patterns, and mathematical text to learn logical reasoning, symbolic representation and to address mathematical queries.
quotes: This hybrid design delivers the processing speed and low memory footprint of a lightweight model without sacrificing the deep awareness required for complex, long-context tasks.
Exposing the model to code helps it to learn the syntax and patterns of programming languages, which improves its ability to generate code and understand code-related questions.
Training on mathematical text helps the model learn logical reasoning, symbolic representation, and to address mathematical queries.
